note: Fine-tune of the previously promoted affine-4/group-64 proposal head (amal-david/qwen38-mtp-head-q2-q4-rerank-v1 @ ae628274, sha256 559b24ebca354018e4402fdb1f5af1afe5a0721bd2ebf04133500d846f7d5f71). All 31 core tensors start from that artifact; the nine side-channel tensors it carries (compact draft readout, permutation maps, exact-row islands) are byte-identical to the parent. Training: the head modules were dequantized to float32 masters and optimized with a distillation cross-entropy whose per-row label is the argmax of the organizer-pinned frozen target's own next-token distribution computed by the unmodified reference forward on teacher-forced text - i.e. the head is trained to place the target's greedy choice at its own top-1, which is exactly the quantity draft acceptance compares. No target weights, transform contract, tokenizer, golden, gate or timing code changed; the backbone contributed only detached hidden states and its lm_head projection inside the loss. Data: 2.02M tokens of public-domain Project Gutenberg prose (Darwin, Herodotus, Plutarch, Hume, Russell, Plato, Sophocles, Adam Smith - the same domains as the timed pool's published description), 3000 non-overlapping 256-token windows, two epochs, Adam lr 1e-5, batch 2. Masters were re-quantized to affine-4/group-64 with MLX's own min/max group recipe on save; decode->requant round-trip against the parent tensors reproduces dequantized values within bf16 rounding (max abs diff < 0.04, zero groups beyond 4x scale). Held-out A/B on a disjoint validation corpus (Swift/YAML/shell/JSON + notes, no overlap with training text): depth-1 acceptance unchanged (0.8769 vs 0.8768), depth-2 effective drafts/round 1.5634 vs 1.5602, depth-8 3.1127 vs 3.0642, adaptive-policy effective length 2.364 vs 0.877 under this corpus mix. The candidate pairs this head with a constant depth-2 draft policy. Everything the head only proposes remains safe by construction: the organizer-pinned target decides every emitted token, the trusted parent re-verifies the whole stream against the hidden serial trajectory after the clock stops, and the row ledger closes over the drafts actually proposed.
